intro: The fire emoji 🔥 long ago outgrew literal flames — today it mostly means 'this is fire,' shorthand for something great, hot, or absolutely lit. This page gathers the core 🔥 itself, the hype-and-approval emoji that pair with it (💯 🚀 ⚡ 🙌 👑), the heat-and-danger symbols like 🌋 and 🥵 that push a message past its limit, and a handful of flame-flavored kaomoji for plain-text chats. Below the sections you'll find one-click combo sets — 'This Is Fire,' 'Absolutely Lit,' and more — built for captions, comments, and hype replies. Copy any single character or grab a whole set at once.
